name: Y'allternative Living Unisex T-Shirt
blurb: The shirt that started the whole shop: a rainbow stag under a crescent moon, screen-printed on soft cotton cut to actually fit everybody. Original artwork, zero mass-production. Wear it to the market, wear it to Pride, wear it everywhere in between.

usageGuide.howToApply: Wear everywhere. Screen-printed on soft ring-spun cotton cut to fit all bodies comfortably.
usageGuide.storage: Machine wash cold inside-out. Tumble dry low. Do not iron directly over screen-printed artwork.
usageGuide.patchTest: 100% ring-spun cotton with skin-friendly water-based discharge screen print ink.
